Author: Quilun
Name: GlamImport
Punchline: Paste a glam from Eorzea Collection and apply it with Glamourer.
Description: Copy a glam page from ffxiv.eorzeacollection.com, paste it in, and the plugin finds the gear and dyes and applies them to your character through Glamourer, or saves them as a Glamourer design. Requires Glamourer.
Changelog: Renamed to GlamImport. Apply to Target, recent imports, Glamourer version check, "Used by" jobs for weapons, outlined dye boxes.
